title: The Crypt That Ate the Light
story: Hollowlamp the Wick Wraith haunts the Crypt of Quiet Bells, and its curse halves the brightness of any lantern once every hour. Mr 6 brought the Bright Bell lantern down to rescue two lost map-makers who had been trapped for hours. He needed to know how dim things would get before the rescue was done.
question: The Bright Bell lantern starts at 640 lumens and the curse halves it every hour; how many lumens remain after 5 hours?
hint: Halve 640 once for the first hour, then halve that result again — count carefully to five halvings.
victory: Knowing exactly how dim it would get, Mr 6 raced the map-makers out with 20 lumens to spare, and Hollowlamp sputtered off to sulk. 'You can't scare a fellow who already did the math,' Mr 6 said.
imagePrompt: A dim stone crypt with carved bells on the walls, a translucent wick-wraith curling around a fading lantern held high by a small numeral-six knight leading two frightened map-makers.
solution: Keep going: 160 → 80 → 40 → 20 after the fourth and fifth halvings.
praise: You spotted that halving repeats each hour — the missing step was counting exactly five halvings, not one fewer.
